title: Glass-Box Deep Reinforcement Learning for High-Speed Flow Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.27132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is challenging long-held assumptions in active flow control. By learning directly from interaction with a flow, DRL agents can find actuation strategies for nonlinear, unsteady flows without explicit models, often exploiting mechanisms that classical control would not anticipate. High-speed flows are a demanding test of this promise: shocks, shock/boundary-layer interactions, transition, aerothermal loading and microsecond-scale dynamics strain both algorithms and hardware. Yet most demonstrations remain idealized, low-speed simulations with limited evidence of robustness, interpretability, transferability or experimental deployment. In this perspective, we examine what constrains DRL-based high-speed flow control, including compressible simulation cost and fidelity, data efficiency, sensing in extreme environments, reward design, explainability, and generalization across Mach and Reynolds number. translated_title: 面向高速流动控制的“玻璃箱”深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（DRL）正在挑战主动流动控制领域长期以来的固有假设。通过直接从与流动的交互中学习，DRL智能体无需显式模型即可为非线性、非定常流动找到驱动（作动）策略，并且常常利用经典控制方法难以预见的机制。高速流动是对这一前景的严苛考验：激波、激波/边界层干扰、转捩、气动热载荷以及微秒尺度的动力学特性，对算法和硬件均构成巨大压力。然而，现有的大多数演示仍停留在理想化的低速仿真中，在鲁棒性、可解释性、可迁移性或实验部署方面证据有限。在这篇展望性文章中，我们分析了制约基于DRL的高速流动控制发展的因素，包括可压缩仿真的成本与保真度、数据效率、极端环境下的传感感知、奖励设计、可解释性，以及跨马赫数和雷诺数的泛化能力。我们认为……
tldr: 本文是一篇展望性文章，系统分析了深度强化学习应用于高速流动控制所面临的关键瓶颈（仿真成本与保真度、数据效率、极端环境感知、奖励设计、可解释性及跨马赫数与雷诺数泛化），并主张发展可解释的“玻璃箱”DRL方法以推动其实验落地。
en_tdlr: This perspective examines the key constraints limiting deep reinforcement learning for high-speed flow control—including simulation cost and fidelity, data efficiency, extreme-environment sensing, reward design, explainability, and generalization across Mach and Reynolds numbers—and advocates interpretable "glass-box" DRL approaches for real-world deployment.
